videos.desc: An anime woman crosses off the day on a big wall calendar with a red crayon, then flips through the pages and points excitedly at a date circled with a little heart, hugging her hands to her chest.

After a timer beep, a woman frantically pulls a sweater over her head, hair standing up with static, while her partner helps her into a scarf, jacket and beanie. She laces boots, checks the full winter outfit in the mirror and gets a thumbs up before hurrying out the door with her bag.

A couple stands at a wall above a small town clinking mugs as the sun sinks behind the hills. The sky slowly darkens from orange sunset to deep blue dusk, the town lights come on and the moon brightens above them.

A fixed night camera shows a woman fast asleep in bed when her dog jumps up, paces over the blanket and nudges and licks her face. She stirs, sits up rubbing her eyes and hides her face laughing while the excited dog stands over her wanting to play.

At an outdoor cafe table with coffee and a croissant, a woman opens a huge broadsheet newspaper that completely hides her face. Her boyfriend leans over as she plays peek-a-boo from behind the pages, then she folds the newspaper up neatly and they leave together laughing.
videos.said: The whole world's in here! Peek-a-boo!

videos.desc: A young couple walks home through a quiet whitewashed village street at night under the moon and street lamps, a black cat trailing them. They say good night at a blue door and the man walks off alone down the dark lane.

Hands fill an empty beige tote bag laid on a bed: a pink water bottle goes into a side pocket, then notebooks and books, a pencil pouch and earphones each find their place. The full bag is zipped up and lifted by its straps, ready to go.
videos.said: I pack my bag for school. I put my books, my bottle, and my pens inside.

videos.desc: On a snowy winter evening a young man and woman in matching checked pyjamas warm them on a radiator, put them on and shuffle around the attic bedroom with hot drinks. They fall backwards onto the bed while their dog naps on the rug.

An animated man in a teal shirt stands at a big wall planner calendar in an office, pinning colored magnets on different days, circling one date with a marker and ticking it, then steps back satisfied saying it is sorted.

A frantic couple turns their apartment upside down searching for lost keys: she digs under couch cushions and through drawers, he crawls under the sofa and shakes out a backpack, they argue by the front door - where the keys turn out to be hanging in the lock the whole time.
videos.said: They were right here! Oh, you're kidding!

videos.desc: At an outdoor beach shower, a young woman in a wetsuit rinses off under the cold water, shrieking and hugging herself, then pulls her laughing friend under the spray; they both rinse the sand off and dry themselves with towels.

In a cozy log cabin a man yawns and stretches, flops onto the bed, pulls the knitted blanket over himself and falls asleep with his eyes closed while a woman reads and a cat watches in the background.
videos.said: Mmmmm. Best spot ever. Half open.

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime garden, a young man picks up a pale bar of soap at a stone outdoor sink, lathers his muddy hands into thick white foam, rinses them under the tap, and admires his clean hands as a bubble floats by.

In a Pixar-style bathroom, a woman in a lilac bathrobe squeezes toothpaste onto her toothbrush, but the paste keeps flowing out into a huge wobbling spiral tower; she stares at it wide-eyed, scrapes a normal blob back onto the brush and happily brushes her teeth.

A Pixar-style muscular man climbs dripping out of a pool, grabs a striped towel from a lounger and rubs his face and hair dry until it stands up in wild spikes; his wet dog shakes water over him, so he laughs and wraps the dog in the towel too.

A cartoon couple in retro 80s tracksuits and headbands strolls along a palm-lined beach boardwalk, the man carrying a grocery bag of vegetables. They walk past beach huts and lampposts, then lean on the railing to look at the sea.
A close-up shows a wristwatch on a young man's arm; he taps its face, reads the time and panics. He and his roommate scramble for their coats and rush out of the apartment, leaving the kitchen empty.

A grey British Shorthair cat crouches on the rim of a white bath filled with pale green water, staring down at two small dark toys floating on the surface. It reaches a front paw down and taps at the water, sending rings spreading out across it. After a few tries it pulls the wet paw back, shakes it and walks off along the rim.

In the living room of a stone-and-wood villa a man in a dark blue shirt and white shorts is looking for something: he turns on the spot, pats himself down, leans over the sofa and checks around the cushions while a woman in a cream robe sits on the sofa watching him. The camera cuts to a sunlit stone ledge by the window where two magazines, a bunch of car keys and a black phone are lying. Back inside, the man walks past the sofa holding the phone up, smiling, and the woman looks up at him.

An animated living room with a low round wooden table, a pale sofa and big windows onto a green garden. A man in a dark blue shirt stands looking worried, then starts hunting through the room: he throws the sofa cushions into the air, crouches down to look under the furniture and turns around again and again. A woman in a cream top sits calmly on the sofa watching him with a small knowing smile. The camera drops to the coffee table, where his phone and a bunch of car keys are lying in plain sight; a hand reaches in and points at them. He looks up, sheepish, picks up the phone, and she stands behind the sofa with her arms folded, pointing at the table.

A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.

In a warm, softly lit hallway with a rug and a potted plant, an enormously fat green cartoon lizard waddles up to a doorway and has to squeeze its round belly through the frame. The door swings shut, and a small dark sign on it reads WC. The hallway sits quiet for a few seconds. Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.

A grown man knots his tie in front of a mirror in a flat, drinks coffee standing up, sits at the kitchen table signing his way through a thick stack of bills and documents, shoulders a work bag and leaves through the front door, then walks to work in a stream of office commuters crossing a city street.

A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.

A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.
